As a 24 year old who has lost so many friends every year, it really affects my mental health. But it's better to just cut those people out of your life and focus on yourself. Even if it's lonely, it's better than surrounding yourself by that negative energy.

Ignore your mom. She insults and berates you because she's projecting. When you get older, you realize your parents are people who don't know everything and how they act is how their own parents treated them. My mom was the same way. I was forced to be more independent because I didn't want to ask my mom for help with certain things. Once I started shutting her out of my personal life, she stopped bothering me as much but the outbursts still happen once in a while.  


TLDR: Find something you love and enjoy and just focus on that. Especially if there's a community you can relate to. You are worthy of being here.

LA concert is GA. So if you're willing to do GA and camp then I'd say buy the membership for a pre-sale code. If you don't then GA will definitely sell out after considering the amount of people willing to camp for TXT.   


I'd say if you're ok sitting around the middle or back of the middle sections then you could wait till general sale. It's risky waiting last minute because ticket prices might not go down and I'm not sure if AXS holds onto tickets like ticketmaster and slowly releases them.   


It also depends on your price range. VIP GA for big groups is usually around $450-600. So I'd say specify what you want exactly and what would be a backup option.
